hotel_name: Hôtel du Couvent, a Luxury Collection Hotel

skipped.reason: no Condé Nast Traveler hotel page found for this name

claims.text: The hotel occupies a 17th-century convent with a garden in Old Nice.

findings.quote: In the old Nice, nestled in the North-Italian part of Provence, lies a convent from the 17th century with a luxurious garden.
A Former Convent Turned Hotel

claims.text: The hotel is located in the pedestrian Old Town of Nice.

findings.quote: We are located in the pedestrian Old Town of Nice.

claims.text: Accommodation ranges from monastic-type cells to apartments with a sea view.

findings.quote: A wide range of accommodation, from monastic-type cells to 166sqm appartements with a sea view

claims.text: Each suite has a dedicated butler.

findings.quote: Each suite has a dedicated Butler, attentive to your needs throughout your stay.

claims.text: Some suites have a private garden with a dining table, or terraces and loggias overlooking the Cour des Orangers.

findings.quote: some suites offer a private outdoor retreat: a garden with a dining table to linger over long summer evenings, or expansive terraces and loggias overlooking the Cour des Orangers

claims.text: Some suites have large kitchens equipped with Lacanche ranges.

findings.quote: Some feature large kitchens equipped with Lacanche ranges, while others highlight a spacious living room and dining area.

claims.text: In the Roman Baths, bathers start in the warm tepidarium, move to the hot caldarium and finish with a plunge in the cool frigidarium.

findings.quote: To enjoy the greatest benefits, bathers are invited to start with the warm water of the tepidarium, followed by the hot caldarium, and finish with a plunge in the cool frigidarium.

claims.text: The Movement Studio runs daily classes including functional training, breathwork, yoga, pilates, floor barre and animal flow.

findings.quote: Our daily classes combine diversity and effectiveness, offering a variety of disciplines: functional training to strengthen the body, breathwork to calm the mind, yoga, pilates, floor barre, and animal flow.

claims.text: The terraced gardens and cloisters overlook the city rooftops and the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: Nestled in a lush, historical setting, these terraced gardens and peaceful cloisters offer a sanctuary of biodiversity rooted in monastic tradition.
all while overlooking the rooftops of the city and the Mediterranean Sea.

claims.text: Plage du Galet on the Promenade des Anglais reserves sunbeds for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Located on the Promenade des Anglais, Plage du Galet welcomes guests for a relaxing day by the Mediterranean. Sunbeds are reserved for Hôtel du Couvent guests.

claims.text: The hotel's own farm, Ferme Notre-Dame in Touët-sur-Var in the hills behind Nice, supplies its kitchens.

findings.quote: In Touët-sur-Var, in the hills of Nice’s hinterland, Ferme Notre-Dame supplies the hotel’s kitchens exclusively
The hotel’s farm, located in Touët-sur-Var in the hinterland of Nice

claims.text: Bread is baked on-site in the room where the convent sisters once prepared their daily loaves.

findings.quote: the bread baked in the bakery oven located in the very room where the sisters once prepared their daily loaves

claims.text: The hotel is the former Visitation convent, set in the heart of the old town and overlooking the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: In the heart of the old town, secluded and overlooking the Mediterranean, the former Visitation convent welcomes visitors

claims.text: As a tribute to the Roman bath remains on the hill in Cimiez, the hotel has a Roman-inspired thermal circuit, with treatments that draw on botanical actives, echoing the garden and the convent pharmacopoeia.

findings.quote: As a tribute to the remains of the Roman baths on the hill in Cimiez, Nice, Hôtel du Couvent presents a Roman-inspired thermal circuit.
Treatments draw on botanical actives, echoing the garden and the convent pharmacopoeia

claims.text: The garden pool looks out over the terracotta rooftops of Nice on one side and the Mediterranean on the other.

findings.quote: Hidden within the serene convent gardens, our 20 meter pool invites you to drift between sky and sea.
it offers an unspoiled panorama over Nice, the city’s terracotta rooftops on one side, the shimmering Mediterranean on the other.

claims.text: Suites are decorated with bespoke furniture, antiques, sculptures, paintings and rare books.

findings.quote: They are decorated with bespoke furniture, antiques, sculptures, paintings, and rare books.

claims.text: A resident herbalist offers guests personalized guidance, handcrafted remedies and teas made with herbs from the garden.

findings.quote: the hotel’s resident herbalist offers guests personalized guidance, handcrafted remedies, and artisanal teas infused with herbs from the garden

claims.text: The hotel is in the pedestrian Old Town: drivers go to the Old Town entrance on rue Centrale, and the valet service can escort guests to the hotel if called before arrival.

findings.quote: We are located in the pedestrian Old Town of Nice. Arriving by car, go to 2 rue Centrale, in front of the Jean Jaurès bookshop, to access the Old Town entrance.
You can also contact our Valet Service on +33 6 85 83 10 33, 15 min prior to your arrival to escort you to the hotel.

claims.text: Rooms are spread across the convent's three buildings, and interiors and views vary from room to room.

findings.quote: Spread across the convent's three buildings, each room is unique; interiors and views vary from room to room.

claims.text: The children's programme runs during school holidays, for ages 4 to 10.

findings.quote: During school holidays, our team cares for children aged 4 to 10.
